lines.2: With nothing else to do, I went fishing with the childhood-friend crew for a change of pace.
lines.3: 「When you said fishing, I thought you meant picking up girls. You mean actual fishing?」
lines.4: 「Playing games all day isn't good for you either.」
lines.5: 「The sea breeze feels healthy... It really is summer now.」
lines.6: The sun's heat and the cool sea breeze balanced each other perfectly.
lines.7: 「Just waiting on Kinu now. She works until two.」
lines.9: I peered down at the sea glittering in the sunlight.
lines.12: 「Just because I'm a crab doesn't mean I'm going to crawl out of the sea!」
lines.14: Ignoring the complaining crab, we began fishing!
lines.15: 「Kid, asking me to put the bait on for you is a little pathetic.」
lines.17: 「If there were girls here, they'd lose all respect for you.」
lines.18: 「Hello? The incarnation of a narcissus flower is standing right here.」
lines.20: 「What's shrimp supposed to mean!? I don't get it, but I'm furious!」
lines.22: Subaru ignored her and kept working.
lines.23: 「If there were a girl here, I'd somehow put the bait on myself.」
lines.24: 「There it is. This guy really likes to look cool.」
lines.25: 「I wanna mess around on a beach like this with cute girls.」
lines.26: 「All you ever talk about is what you want.」
lines.27: 「What's something you'd like a girl to say to you?」
lines.28: 「Come on, sometimes I wish they'd just leave me alone.」
lines.32: 「But do you think dreams like that will ever come true for me?」
lines.33: 「You'll be fine. You're the kind of kid who can do it if you try.」
lines.36: 「Hell yeah! Today I'm gonna have all the fun I can to prepare for that!」
lines.38: 「Kinu, what would you want a guy to say to you?」
lines.40: 「Maybe: 'You shine brighter than the giant diamond in a museum. If you're too beautiful, they'll declare you a Living National Treasure!' Something like that.」
lines.41: 「I think that would count as making fun of you...」
lines.42: 「Still, Leo, you get along pretty well with Otome.」
lines.43: 「She's basically a very good person... though there are plenty of things I'd like her to ease up on.」
lines.44: 「Watch yourself. Older sisters are scary. They'll delete your RPG save data and stuff.」
lines.45: 「She's terrible with computers, so I'm safe.」
lines.46: Hanging out with these guys really did relax me.
lines.47: I'd been a little hung up on Konoe that morning, but now I didn't care anymore.
